All nonzero matrices in their union are singular vertices. Inclusion–exclusion, removal of zero, and removal of the original vertex A when A²=0 give deg=2q^{n(n-r)}−q^{(n-r)^2}−1−1_{A²=0}. For t=n−r the degree center f(t) strictly increases with gaps >1, so it determines rank and square-zero status. Standard rank enumeration and flag count S_{n,r}=[n r]_q[n−r r]_q|GL_r(q)| give exact multiplicities (S=0 for 2r>n).
